en: Fixed `claude agents` starting a new background service as it exited when both were stopped with a session open (for example at a reboot), which could delay shutdown and restart an interrupted session
zh: 修复了在 session 打开状态下同时停止 `claude agents` 和后台服务时，`claude agents` 在退出时又启动新的后台服务的问题（例如重启时），该问题可能延迟关机并重启被中断的 session
